stem:
Anil brings a magnet near an iron nail and near a plastic ruler. The nail is attracted to the magnet. The ruler is not.

Which conclusion is correct?

options.text: The nail is magnetic; the ruler is non-magnetic.
The nail is non-magnetic; the ruler is magnetic.
Both are magnetic because Anil used a magnet.
Both are non-magnetic because only one object moved.

teacher.key_rationale: Attraction means magnetic material; no attraction means non-magnetic. The nail is magnetic; the ruler is not.
